tasks.title: DeletePodDialog re-focuses when its Pod changes while open
acceptance: C1. `DialogFocusOptions` in `src/renderer/src/shell/use-dialog-focus.ts` gains exactly one new optional member, documented by a TSDoc comment. While `open` is true, a change in its value re-runs the open path: focus moves to `initialFocus` if given, otherwise to the dialog element. Leaving it out keeps today's behaviour. `DeletePodDialog` passes its Pod's id (`podId`, not the `pod` object) as that member. The hook's existing members and their defaults are unchanged.

C2 (D7; frontend discipline, Accessibility floor: 'Focus is visible, and it moves predictably after an action that changes what is on screen'). A test in `src/renderer/src/pods/DeletePodDialog.test.tsx` renders the dialog open on Pod A (`id: 'a'`), moves focus to the Cancel button, and asserts that focus is not on the dialog element (vacuity guard). It then rerenders directly to a Pod with a different id, never passing through `pod={null}`, and asserts `document.activeElement` is the dialog element (`DELETE_POD_TEST_IDS.dialog`).
